verified_facts.text: The hotel is a twelfth-century castle with Renaissance frescoes and contemporary interiors by Milanese designer Paola Navone.
verified_facts.excerpt: a twelfth-century castle with Renaissance frescoes and contemporary interiors by Milanese designer Paola Navone

verified_facts.text: The castle is set within a 740-acre historic estate in the heart of Chianti.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within a 740-acre historic estate in the heart of Chianti

verified_facts.text: Podere San Filippo, on the estate, offers twelve self-catering apartments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within the 740-acre COMO Castello Del Nero estate, Podere San Filippo offers twelve elegant self-catering apartments

verified_facts.text: Villa San Luigi is a five-bedroom private villa surrounded by vineyards and olive groves, with a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: An exclusive five-bedroom private villa surrounded by vineyards and olive groves, Villa San Luigi combines complete privacy with bespoke COMO service.

verified_facts.text: By car, the resort is 30 minutes from Florence's airport and 75 minutes from Pisa's airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: By car, the resort is 30 minutes from Florence's airport, 75 minutes from Pisa's airport, and three hours from Rome's airport.

verified_facts.text: The hotel received a One MICHELIN Key in the 2024 and 2025 MICHELIN Guide Italy Key Hotel selection.
verified_facts.excerpt: COMO Castello Del Nero has been recognised with a One MICHELIN Key in both the 2024 and 2025 MICHELIN Guide Italy Key Hotel selection.

verified_facts.text: La Torre holds one Michelin star in the MICHELIN Guide Italy 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Torre (one Michelin star)

verified_facts.text: La Torre is overseen by Executive Chef Giovanni Luca Di Pirro.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Torre is overseen by Executive Chef, Giovanni Luca Di Pirro.

verified_facts.text: La Taverna is a casual bar in the castle's original twelfth-century kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: A casual bar in the castle’s original twelfth-century kitchen.

verified_facts.text: Pavilion offers al fresco Mediterranean dining overlooking Chianti's hills and olive groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pavilion offers 'al fresco' Mediterranean dining, overlooking Chianti’s rolling hills and ancient olive groves.

verified_facts.text: A monthly Friday evening barbecue is held in the olive groves from April to September.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a monthly Friday evening barbecue in our olive groves from April to September.

verified_facts.text: The 25-metre outdoor swimming pool is heated and open during the summer months.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated and open during the summer months

verified_facts.text: The thermal suites include an ice fountain, sauna, steam room and heated vitality pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: An ice fountain, gentle sauna, invigorating shower, aromatic steam room and heated vitality pool

verified_facts.text: The spa has a yoga studio and a Pilates studio fitted with Cadillac-Reformer machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: our sun-filled yoga studio and Pilates studio fitted with Cadillac-Reformer machines

verified_facts.text: The estate has four hiking paths, one tennis court and one padel court.
verified_facts.excerpt: Four hiking paths, an indoor fitness centre, one tennis court and one padel court, a Pilates studio and a yoga studio

verified_facts.text: A shuttle to and from Florence and Siena runs every other day and is complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shuttle service to and from Florence and Siena every other day

verified_facts.text: There is a helipad at the property.

verified_facts.text: Heritage Suites in the main building feature original frescoed walls, ceilings and fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: These outstanding historical suites in the main building feature original frescoed walls, ceilings and fireplaces.

verified_facts.text: The COMO Suite is a two-bedroom suite in the Belvedere outbuilding, suited to families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the ‘Belvedere’ outbuilding with a magnificent entrance, this suite is ideal for families.

verified_facts.text: The resort produces its own olive oil, wine and flour for internal use and keeps a chef's garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort produces its own olive oil, wine, and flour for internal use, and maintains a chef’s garden where seasonal vegetables are grown on site.

verified_facts.text: Truffle hunting is a one-hour guided hunt followed by a four-course lunch at Pavilion.

verified_facts.text: Each October the estate offers an olive harvest experience in its olive groves.
